answer: A sonnet keeps its form only if each line is earned, so standing resets every epoch. Each identity needs two holders outside its own prism to countersign its stanza, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n distinct witnesses rather than one cooperative crew. Every line is priced by rank: the k-th line an operator files costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still needing unrelated guarantors. A zephyr audit replays a random stanza each epoch, and an unconfirmed line voids the whole prism and forfeits its bonds.
